proof: For n nonnegative regrets sorted ascending, the usual median equals zero iff at least floor(n/2)+1 entries are zero. For even n both middle entries must vanish; for odd n the middle entry must vanish. Hence zero-threshold allele admission equals strict-majority zero-regret support, with ties supporting both alleles. Singleton selection additionally requires the other allele not be admitted.
scope: Algebraic characterization of the realized zero threshold, not a new statistical guarantee or biological truth claim.
